label: commented on
definition: Entity X made an explicit statement or comment about entity Y.
scope_notes: Includes: say-of, comment-on, or a statement explicitly referring to Y; explicit praise, criticism, or accusation about Y; historical attributed statements. Excludes: speaking to Y without establishing that Y is the subject; ordinary interaction or comparison without a statement by X; a statement about someone else related to Y. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear speaker or subject attachment; a quotation or reference without an identifiable statement about Y. The argument Y is the topic, not necessarily the addressee. This is distinct from communicates_to; do not infer an evaluation or sentiment merely from comment.

facts.reason: Democrats → A. Gephardt: Reaction to Gephardt's comments and references to his words do not specify a statement by Democrats about Gephardt.
facts.reviewer_question: Did Democrats make an explicit statement about Gephardt, or are the words and comments attributed to Gephardt himself?

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.
